candidates.change_summary: Replace the external call to send Ether with a transfer (using .transfer) which reverts on failure and uses 2300 gas instead of call.
Perform the external call before zeroing the caller's credit (making the contract vulnerable to reentrancy that can change the resulting state after withdrawAll).
Remove the require on the external call result so a failed send does not revert and credit remains zeroed but balance already decreased (silent failure case).
Set the caller's credit to oCredit instead of zeroing it, so the state after withdrawAll retains the same credit value (changing observable state).
After successful send, increment the caller's credit by 1 (introducing an observable change to credit after withdrawAll).
